candidates.description: These tokens represent relative pronouns, interrogative words, and subordinate conjunctions used to introduce clauses or ask questions across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents Spanish grammatical suffixes, inflectional morphemes, and word-formation roots.
This vector represents words related to using, utilization, and application in Spanish and English.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to illegal, taboo, or criminal acts and substances, as well as frequent linguistic suffixes sharing similar orthographic patterns.
This feature activates for terms related to neurology, neurobiology, and medical conditions or biological substances.
These tokens are fragments of Latin-root words, particularly relating to containment, carriage, and bodily or systemic functions across English, French, and Spanish.

This vector represents morphological components, stems, and suffixes associated with the root for making or doing (derived from Latin *facere*), frequently appearing across various Spanish and English words.
These tokens represent common suffixes and root endings characteristic of Spanish grammatical morphemes and adverbial forms.
This feature vector represents anatomical terms and medical body systems.
This vector activates for common Spanish modal and auxiliary verbs expressing possibility, obligation, and state.
